fields.statement: Which intent should change set 01M6T1ZR (Fix the usage governor's limits) serve? milestone-29 is the only open milestone; its done point m29-one-daemon names 'one usage governor' for the root daemon. / The intent says one 10:45Z hit taught both the session and weekly limits. The code already teaches only the kind KindOf gives (reset ≤5h = session); the live hits file shows that weekly limit came from a leaked fake test hit with a 4-day reset, which change set 01M6T20E fixes. What does 01M6T1ZR do about that point? / How should a learned usage limit move up when a window's use passes it with no limit hit in that window (e.g. after the owner's upgrade to Max 20x)? / usageHoldOf adds the mean run tokens for each live run, though those runs' tokens so far are already in the window's use. How should a live run count in the projection?
